content.value: A rocket of proper length 400 meters is moving directly away from the earth. A light pulse sent from the earth is reflected from mirrors at the rear and front of the rocket. If the first of these reflected pulses is received back 120 sec after the emission and second one after 15μsec later. Calculate (i) the distance of the rocket from the earth, (ii) the velocity of the rocket and (iii) its apparent length.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
